about_the_game:
Increminer is a frantic incremental pixel-art platformer where you dig deeper and deeper for valuable ore to sell. Use your riches to upgrade your abilities to delve further into the depths that await. You may even find a valuable artifact or two to donate to the Museum. Can you find them all? 

Scaling Incremental Gameplay

Do you love seeing the numbers go up? If so, then this game is for you! Each level culminates in a bedrock reality check demanding that you've upgraded enough. Run out of time and you're gonna need to return for another run with better upgrades.

Game Changing Upgrades

The upgrades don't only make the numbers go up. They can also provide completely new abilities!

A rock blocking your way to something good? Get the bomb pouch. 

Fall too far down and miss something? Should have bought the grapple gun.

Feeling like mining is a bit slow? Time to upgrade to the drill.

Need to tear through the ground faster? Chain lightning should help.

Collect-a-thon

Each unique level has a chance to have a rare artifact! Artifacts sell for serious cash, however the local Museum would prefer you donate to their collection, of course. Either way, the choice is yours.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 or later / SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2 compatible GPU (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple Silicon (M1 or newer)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / Apple M1 integrated GPU
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: Dig, sell, upgrade and repeat! Increminer is a pixel art incremental platformer where the only way to complete the Museum's collection is to mine your way through each unique biome and discover the artifacts hidden within. Sell your findings to upgrade your mining prowess and unlock new abilities!
